nodes.name: Booking Webhook
nodes.notes: Lo llama Qualifier · Inbound: mode=offer (el lead calificó) o mode=choose (el lead respondió a los horarios). Síncrono. Protegido por x-qualifier-token.

parameters.query:
SELECT s.*, (SELECT body FROM messages_log WHERE message_id = $2) AS latest_body,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM suppression_list x WHERE x.key = lower(s.email) OR x.key = norm_phone(s.phone, '57')) AS suppressed,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('direction', h.direction, 'body', h.body) ORDER BY h.id)
            FROM (SELECT id, direction, body FROM messages_log WHERE contact_id = $1 AND message_id <> $2 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 8) h), '[]'::jsonb) AS history
FROM conversation_state s WHERE s.contact_id = $1

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bookings (contact_id, appointment_id, slot_start)
SELECT $1, 'mock-' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), $2::timestamptz
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mock_calendar_busy WHERE slot_start = $2::timestamptz)
ON CONFLICT (slot_start) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, appointment_id

nodes.name: Persist Booking
nodes.notes: Rep, estado "booked", etapa de oportunidad (mirror de GHL) y confirmación en la cola de salida: UNA sentencia.

nodes.name: Dispatch Confirmation
nodes.notes: La confirmación es transaccional: sale aunque ya pasara el horario laboral (Send Message lo permite solo para este tipo).

nodes.name: Build Offer
nodes.notes: Ofrece hasta 3 horarios repartidos en días distintos, en la zona horaria del lead. El texto lo arma el código, no la IA.

parameters.content:
## Qualifier · Booking
Offer: free calendar slots → 2-3 options in the lead's time zone. Choose: the AI maps the reply to an OFFERED slot id (validated in code) → create appointment (a double booking is impossible) → confirm + notify the assigned rep. Anything that cannot continue goes to a human.

### Per-step log → Postgres
Nodes "Log · …" and "Side · …": side branches.
